_comment: The shelves the front page sorts championships onto, in the order they appear. A championship is filed by its folder name; anything not listed here still shows up, under 'Unsorted'. Accent is a colour stem and must be one of the ones app/lib/category-accents.ts knows: amber, sky, emerald, rose, violet, cyan, zinc. 'banner' is optional and points at a file under public/; without it the category borrows the banner of the first championship in it that has one.

categories.name: Test Drive
categories.description: Accolade's road duel, run for real: exotics from the 1987 lineup and the 1989 Duel, on circuits and on open roads with traffic.

categories.name: Grand Prix
categories.description: Works teams and open-wheelers, from the riding-mechanic era to the last of the front-engined cars.

categories.name: Formula 1
categories.description: The World Championship years: three formulas in eleven seasons, from the supercharged Alfettas to the last of the front-engined cars.

categories.name: Endurance
categories.description: Long races, decided by whatever is still running at the end of them.

categories.name: Open Road
categories.description: Racing on roads that were never circuits: passes, coast roads and the long way between two towns.

categories.name: Road Cars
categories.description: Showroom machinery taken racing, with the number plates left on.

categories.name: Touring Cars
categories.description: Saloons, and the national championships built around them.
